title: Rebuild state from history, not process memory
description: Inject a failure, scrub the recorded timeline, and change replay compatibility and external idempotency. The model separates Workflow recovery from business side effects.

codeContracts.label: Replay-compatible Workflow code
codeContracts.detail: The same history produces the same command sequence.

codeContracts.label: Unversioned command change
codeContracts.detail: New code inserts or removes a command that old history did not record.

incidents.label: Workflow Worker crashes
incidents.detail: The Activity result is already recorded when the Workflow Worker process disappears.

events.label: WorkflowExecutionStarted
events.detail: The order input and Workflow type are durable.

events.label: ActivityTaskScheduled
events.detail: The Workflow commands one logical payment Activity.

events.label: ActivityTaskCompleted
events.detail: The charge result is recorded in Event History.

events.label: Workflow Worker process stops
events.detail: Cached Workflow state is lost, but Event History remains.

events.label: History replays on another Worker
events.detail: The recorded Activity result is returned without charging again.

incidents.label: Activity completion is not recorded
incidents.detail: The provider accepted the charge, but the Activity Worker stops before Temporal records completion.

events.label: WorkflowExecutionStarted
events.detail: The order input and Workflow type are durable.

events.label: ActivityTaskScheduled
events.detail: The Workflow schedules one logical charge Activity.

events.label: Payment provider commits
events.detail: The side effect exists outside Temporal, but completion is not durable yet.

events.label: Attempt times out
events.detail: The missing completion is detected and the Retry Policy permits another attempt.

events.label: ActivityTaskStarted
events.detail: Another Worker starts attempt 2 with the same business operation ID.

events.label: ActivityTaskCompleted
events.detail: The provider result from the guarded retry is recorded.

incidents.label: New Workflow code meets old history
incidents.detail: A running execution is picked up by a deployment whose command sequence changed without versioning.
incidents.failureBoundary: During replay on the new Worker deployment

events.label: WorkflowExecutionStarted
events.detail: Version 1 of the Workflow began the order.

events.label: TimerStarted
events.detail: Version 1 recorded a wait before scheduling payment.

events.label: Version 2 Worker replays
events.detail: The Worker must emit commands compatible with the events produced by version 1.

events.label: Next command matches
events.detail: Worker Versioning or a recorded patch keeps the execution on a compatible branch.
